high_level_description: The image is an abstract piece of art featuring bold, geometric shapes and a limited color palette. The background is a gradient of dark gray at the top transitioning to a lighter gray and then to a vibrant red at the bottom. The central focus of the artwork consists of several overlapping shapes: Red Square: A large square occupies most of the center of the composition. It serves as the backdrop for the other shapes. Green Ellipse: A green ellipse is positioned diagonally across the red square, adding a dynamic element to the composition.
